name: @tagalong/desktop

scripts.test:e2e: node scripts/ensure-electron.mjs && electron-vite build && playwright test
scripts.package:win: node scripts/ensure-electron.mjs && node scripts/fetch-native.mjs win32 x64 && electron-vite build && electron-builder --win nsis --x64 --publish never
scripts.package:mac: node scripts/ensure-electron.mjs && electron-vite build && electron-builder --mac dmg --publish never
scripts.package:linux: node scripts/ensure-electron.mjs && electron-vite build && electron-builder --linux AppImage deb --publish never
scripts.package:dir: node scripts/ensure-electron.mjs && electron-vite build && electron-builder --dir --publish never

description: Tagalong: a crew of AI companions that tag along on your screen.
author: Tagalong
